description: Start a minimax-h3 generation from one photo. mode='basic': user_prompt (scene description) + requested_duration_s (5-15); the model animates the photo and generates the soundtrack itself. mode='reference': one audio_clip_id drives the clip with lip-sync (first 15 s billed); user_prompt is optional; up to 8 extra image / 3 video / 2 audio reference_files with reference_captions keep a product or background consistent. Output is 768 px on the short side, orientation follows the photo. Cost 3.3 credits per billed second, charged on create. Returns the job id; call wait_for_job(model='minimax-h3') until done (1-3 min).

audio_clip_id.description: Reference mode: the clip that drives the video

reference_captions.description: One caption per reference file, same order

reference_files.description: Reference mode: local paths of extra reference images/videos/audio

user_prompt.description: Scene / motion description (required in basic mode)

name: create_minimax_h3_video
title: Create a MiniMax H3 clip (up to 15 s)
